description: This file defines the RoboMakerClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS RoboMaker service. It contains method annotations for various synchronous and asynchronous API calls offered by the service, indicating that this class extends a generic AWS client with RoboMaker-specific methods.

classes.name: RoboMakerClient
classes.description: A PHP client for AWS RoboMaker that provides methods to interact with the service, such as creating, describing, deleting simulation jobs, robots, worlds, etc.

methods.name: batchDeleteWorlds
methods.description: Deletes one or more worlds in AWS RoboMaker.

methods.name: createSimulationJob
methods.description: Creates a simulation job in RoboMaker.

methods.name: describeWorld
methods.description: Returns detailed information about a world.
